fields.name: Vintage Library Shelves
fields.description: Vertical view of multiple shelves packed with antique, leather-bound books in a library.

fields.name: Gritty Found Objects
fields.description: Gritty, close-up shot of dirty, decaying cloth and paper scraps, including a vintage ticket marked '20'.

fields.name: Wall of Sound
fields.description: A wall installation of music amplifiers (Marshall, Epiphone, Vox) and stacks of CDs/tapes surrounding a retro TV.

fields.name: Rusted Garden Gate
fields.description: Close-up of a rusted, weathered metal gate/doorframe with out-of-focus palm plants in the background.

fields.name: Stack of Vintage Suitcases
fields.description: A stacked pile of colorful, vintage leather and fabric suitcases with travel stickers.

fields.name: Soft-Focus White Blossoms
fields.description: Soft-focus, brightly lit close-up of clusters of small white spring blossoms on a tree branch.

fields.name: Rocky Vista at Sunset
fields.description: A rugged hilltop landscape bathed in the warm, hazy glow of sunset.

fields.name: Woman in Rapeseed Field
fields.description: A cinematic view of a woman running through a vast, golden field at twilight.

fields.name: Love Locks on Rusty Grid
fields.description: Padlocks symbolizing lasting romance fastened to a dark, rusted metal grid.

fields.name: Classic Yellow Mercedes-Benz
fields.description: A detailed, moody shot of a vintage yellow Mercedes-Benz coupe on an overcast day.

fields.name: Eclectic Interior Still Life
fields.description: A vibrant, bohemian stack of books, plants, and antiques against a brick wall and gold mirror.

fields.name: Vintage Film Projector and Reels
fields.description: A nostalgic collection of a classic film projector and large movie reels with a moody, retro vibe.

fields.name: Denim Jacket on Vintage 4x4
fields.description: An old-school Land Rover parked in scrubland, with a denim jacket hanging on the door.

fields.name: Soft Focus Sunflower in Field
fields.description: A close-up of a warm-toned sunflower, focusing on its texture against a dark, dramatic background.

fields.name: Flowers Through Gold Frame
fields.description: A hand holding a small, ornate gold frame to capture delicate white blossoms.

fields.name: Vinyl Records and Woman
fields.description: An overhead view of a woman surrounded by and posing with classic vinyl records on a patterned rug.
